# SuperNetrix

SuperNetrix is a software development agency building SaaS platforms, AI automation systems, mobile apps, web applications, admin portals, dashboards, CRM workflows, and automation for startups, SMEs, and growing teams worldwide.

## Services

- SaaS platform development
- AI workflow automation
- Mobile app development
- Web application development
- Backend API development
- Admin portals and dashboards
- CRM and workflow systems
- Cloud deployment and launch support

## Featured Work

- MoneyOS: finance operating system
- Breyus: B2B trade platform
- Di-Twin API: health platform backend
- Onsite: construction collaboration platform
- EverKind AI UGC: AI content pipeline
- GG Krishi: WhatsApp MRV and AI image validation workflow
- SiteSales AI: construction sales intelligence platform
- PowerBlog: SEO publishing platform
- Digital Twin: enterprise data visualization
- VoiceGuard AI: call analytics platform
